tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Near-neutral, faintly cool off-white in light (partisan-neutral, calm); warm near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: post cards, panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: diff headers, inset wells, code blocks, hover fills, sidebars.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of the SECONDARY (neutral solid) button. Visibly darker than surface-sunken so the button reads as solid on the page and inside sidebars.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: handles, timestamps, captions, source publishers.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary accent FILL (DEFAULT; user-overridable at runtime): buttons, nav selection, selection highlight, wordmark dot. Burnt caramel / bright gold.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon ON an accent fill. White on caramel, near-black on gold. The accent picker MUST set this per chosen color, or a pale override breaks contrast.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent color for SMALL TEXT on a surface (eyebrows, chips, ref IDs, links). Deeper than accent in light so small gold text stays legible on white.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Low-saturation accent wash: chip backgrounds, selected-row fills, hover states.

tokens.name: signal-add
tokens.usage: Additions in diffs/revisions AND success UI states. Reserved green.

tokens.name: signal-del
tokens.usage: Removals in diffs/revisions AND error/destructive UI states. Reserved red.

tokens.name: signal-add-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind an addition line or a success message.

tokens.name: signal-del-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind a removal line or an error message.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning / caution. Violet — the one hue separable from the gold accent, red (error), and green. On a fill use white text in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind a warning badge, banner, or row.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modal dialogs and overlays.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical hue 1 (teal). Chips, speaker tags, reference highlights, chart series. NOT a status color.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Categorical hue 2 (blue).

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Categorical hue 3 (cyan). Close to cat-1; don't rely on teal+cyan as the only pair.

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Categorical hue 4 (slate).

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Categorical hue 5 (plum).

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Categorical hue 6 (pine). A green, but only in chips/series, never inside a diff where signal-add lives.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Did the city cut library hours?

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Reading text: post body, article content. The reading tier.
styles.sample: The claim traveled faster than the correction.

styles.name: pullquote
styles.sample: The reduction was closer to twelve percent.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and status pills. Use with text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Diff lines, raw source, reference IDs.

styles.name: mono-num
styles.usage: Tabular counts and metrics. Pair with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: 2px. Hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px. Tightest gap: icon-to-label, chip internals.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: 6px.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px. Small gap between chips, inline controls.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: 10px.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px. Default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px. Card inner padding, standard block spacing.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 20px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px. Section separation within a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: 40px. Major section breaks on a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 48px. Largest standard step.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: 4px. The single corner radius for everything rectangular — buttons, inputs, tags, cards, panels, dialogs. One uniform corner across the whole UI.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Fully round: status pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for post cards and panels.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and large overlays.
